experienceGoal.playerProblem: 捕食後も上端には微小な菱形しか見えず、捕食の進行・失う戦利品・高まりつつある警戒を読み取れないため、もう一体を狙うか帰るかを判断できない。
experienceGoal.targetState: 同じ上端の余白で、捕食進行・未確保の戦利品・警戒段階を読み取れ、戦闘中も続行と帰還を判断できる。
successSignals: 新鮮な狩りの0/2から捕食後の1/2への進行が画像上で文字として読める。
最初の捕食後、未確保2と警戒気配が、命ゲージ・停止・帰還ガイドを隠さず画像上で読める。

observation.summary: Native pointer play reached two combats and the first devour. Actual 02-hunt-entry, 03-play-04 and 03-play-13 screenshots show almost only tiny diamonds on the parchment while captured native DOM contains 人影0/2, then 人影1/2・未確保2・警戒気配. This is missing decision information, not a request for more HUD chrome.

conditions.route: armed brand native tap > begin > native swipes toward traveller > combat > devour > pause > lineage

notVerified: Physical Pixel Fold frame rate and touch feel

evidence.statement: An explicit light bone color on descendant spans wins over the dark ink inherited from hunt-bag; native values exist but disappear against parchment in actual screenshots.
A fixed narrow one-line bag inherits the old shaped objective clip and fades to .45 in combat; newly relevant haul and pressure cannot reliably share the available strip.

candidateProblems.evidence: 02-hunt-entry,03-play-04,03-play-13 actual PNGs; native quota, haul and pressure disappear into parchment.
03-play-04 blue spherical body and detached limbs weaken creature identity; separate model scope.
Dim phase letters during contact; recent #1415 combat scope deliberately retained.
05-lineage lists acquired ability names without their gameplay effect; separate growth recognition problem.

historyReview.retryJustification: This repairs newly observed rendered contrast and composition, not the already adopted zero-state disclosure or combat-contact theme. #1309 explicitly left post-consumption/high-pressure staged visuals unverified. Preserve zero haul/quiet pressure suppression and #1415 native vitals/contact ownership.
doNotRetry: DOM presence as a substitute for visual evidence
New synthetic combat advantage or modified Tidebreak authority

rootCauses.summary: Goal, unsecured stake and potential extraction are composed inline without a bounded display model for their different decision roles.
rootCauses.observationEvidence: 03-play-13 native captured text has all three values but the screenshot does not expose them.
rootCauses.sourceEvidence: HuntFlowUi.update emits a growing inline haul string beside goal and pressure into one fixed-width flex line.
rootCauses.prediction: A pure native-state projection keeps quota, unsecured stake and earned bonus distinct and supplies stable text/visibility for bounded rows.
rootCauses.falsifier: Projection disagrees with game.goalReady, marked prey completion, carried stake or quiet-state disclosure.

rootCauses.summary: Legacy light descendant color and shaped clipping survive the parchment HUD; combat fading and fixed nowrap width further erase decision facts.
rootCauses.symbol: #objective span; ominous-shell #objective clip; hunt-minimal combat opacity
rootCauses.observationEvidence: Actual entry and post-consume PNGs show only the red glyphs, not the native counters.
rootCauses.sourceEvidence: Explicit #objective span color overrides inherited ink; minimal HUD does not reset clip-path and uses width205px/nowrap/opacity.45.
rootCauses.prediction: Scoped span ink, unclipped objective and two-row layout expose the same native counters without covering life or pause.
rootCauses.falsifier: After PNGs remain unreadable, native values are clipped, or narrow layout overlaps controls.

hypothesis.cause: The state exists, but inline composition and a legacy cascade hide the information required to choose continued hunting versus extraction.
hypothesis.prediction: A small native display projection and scoped parchment layout make quota, unsecured stake and pressure jointly readable without changing any hunt rule.
hypothesis.falsifier: Unchanged-state After still hides counters, misrepresents unsecured/secured rewards, or obstructs life/pause/return guidance.

candidates.reason: Repair the current decision surface and its state projection, retaining progressive disclosure and all mechanics.
Duplicates information, hides the world and leaves the underlying cascade and unbounded inline composition unresolved.

implementation.summary: Project native decision values into explicit goal/stake/pressure fields and render them in a readable, unclipped two-row parchment region.

workItems.summary: Extract and bind a pure display projection preserving native quota, marked target, unsecured stake, ready bonus and quiet disclosure.
workItems.evidence: Leaf regression cases compare fresh, consumed, goal-ready and marked-incomplete states; native After values cross-check the visible labels.
workItems.expectedPlayerFacingEffect: The player can distinguish progress, what can be lost, and what returning would secure.

workItems.summary: Override the legacy light span color and shaped clip; reserve two rows between life and pause and keep decision facts readable in combat.
workItems.evidence: Scoped stylesheet regression assertions plus actual immutable native-play PNGs and read-only geometry at 673px and narrow viewport.
workItems.expectedPlayerFacingEffect: Quota, unsecured stake and pressure are readable together instead of vanishing into parchment.

limitations: Pure tests cannot establish visual readability; actual native-play PNGs are required.
Hosted SwiftShader is not a physical-device performance benchmark.
No broad balance simulation, later chapter or cross-app sweep.

workItemCoverage.evidence: hunt-stakes-state.test.mjs fresh/consume/ready/marked/immutability cases and native observed values.
Scoped cascade/composition assertions and actual immutable Before/After images with control geometry.
